sources.note: The Australian National University's own scholarship page for the ANU Vice-Chancellor's International Achievement Award (study.anu.edu.au, ANU's official study site; page title 'ANU Vice-Chancellor's International Achievement Award | The Australian National University').

'Conditions of Award (63/2026)' PDF linked from the official page (dated 16 Feb 2026, i.e. current cycle). The link exists, but the fetched content was raw PDF bytes and could not be parsed; not used as evidence.

awarding_body.detail: The page is on ANU's official domain and states both that ANU offers the award and that ANU funds it, matching the record's awarding body 'The Australian National University'.
awarding_body.quote: The Australian National University (ANU) may offer a number of awards known as the ANU Vice-Chancellor's International Achievement Award. ... Funding for this Award is provided by the Australian National University.

deadline.detail: The page publishes no closing date: the Application period is listed as open, and consideration is automatic with the admissions application. This matches the record's rolling deadline claim ('ANU publishes no closing date for this award; consideration is automatic with the admissions application') and is a currently-open cycle.
deadline.quote: Application period / Open for applications ... There is no need to apply for the scholarship. All eligible students applying for admission to commence at the university will be automatically considered.

eligibility.detail: Every eligibility claim in the record is confirmed on the page: international student; new commencing student or continuing student with an offer of admission to a higher AQF level; residential status in China (including Taiwan, Hong Kong SAR and Macau SAR), Japan, Mongolia, Republic of Korea or the DPRK; Selection Rank of 85 or equivalent (undergraduate) or minimum GPA of 5.5 (postgraduate); no external sponsorship covering all or part of tuition; award offered only once at each level. The page adds two exceptions to the once-per-level rule the record omits: progression from an AQF 7 bachelor degree to a one-year Honours (AQF 8) program, or a packaged offer (e.g. Graduate Certificate leading to a Master's).
eligibility.quote: The Award is available to an ANU student who: 1. is an international student; 2. is a new commencing student or a continuing student who has received an offer of admission to a higher AQF level of studies; 3. holds residential status in one of the following Countries or Regions: China (including Taiwan, Hong Kong SAR and Macau SAR), Japan, Mongolia, Republic of Korea, The Democratic People's Republic of Korea; 4. meets the minimum academic entry requirements: undergraduate applicants: a Selection Rank of 85 (or equivalent as determined by the University) or above, or postgraduate applicants: a minimum GPA of 5.5 (or equivalent); 5. is not the recipient of an external sponsorship that covers all or part of the students tuition fees at the University; and 6. acknowledges that the award can be offered only once at each level of study, except where an applicant progresses from an undergraduate degree (AQF Level 7) to a one-year Honours program (AQF Level 8), or accepts a packaged offer (e.g., a Graduate Certificate leading to a Master's degree).

funding.detail: The record's funding type 'Fee Reduction' is confirmed: the award is a tuition discount of 20% of first-year fees, paid for one year, not a full scholarship. Books, accommodation and other costs are not covered.
funding.quote: Value: 20% off your first-year tuition fees. ... The duration of the Award is one year, with the tuition scholarship applied towards tuition at the start of each semester. ... Recipients of the Award are responsible for the costs of books, study materials, accommodation and all other costs of study.

degree_levels.detail: The record's levels (Undergraduate, Master's) are both offered. The page lists a slightly wider set of study levels: 'Undergraduate/Bachelor, Honours, Postgraduate/Masters, and Graduate certificate', and describes the objective as enrolling overseas students in 'undergraduate and postgraduate coursework programs'. This is an enrichment, not a contradiction.
degree_levels.quote: Study level: Undergraduate/Bachelor, Honours, Postgraduate/Masters, and Graduate certificate

recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Official ANU page read 2026-10-12; application period open, no closing date published, automatic consideration with the admissions application. Value 20% off first-year tuition fees for one year (fee reduction, not fully funded). Consider expanding degree_levels to include Honours and Graduate certificate per the page's Study level list, and noting the once-per-level exceptions (Honours progression, packaged offers) in eligibility_summary. Page links 'Conditions of Award (63/2026)' (16 Feb 2026) as PDF.

notes_for_reviewer: No material contradictions found. Two optional catalogue enrichments: (1) degree_levels could be broadened to 'Undergraduate, Honours, Master's, Graduate certificate'; (2) eligibility_summary could mention the once-per-level exceptions (AQF 7 to one-year Honours AQF 8 progression, packaged offers). The linked Conditions of Award PDF exists (63/2026) but its text could not be parsed during this check; it is not needed to confirm the page's claims.
